method: Every non-reprint card from Lorwyn Eclipsed through Reality Fracture (and their Commander decks) was checked against the 20 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Hazel decks on Moxfield and EDHREC's Hazel pages, then filtered for tokens, Squirrels and sacrifice. Game Changers excluded.
summary: Hazel copies a token each end step and doubles Squirrels, so The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl and changeling token makers are the top new cards. The badge on each card counts the sources that include it; "Claude's pick" means no list runs it yet.

sets.name: EDHREC Recommendations
